chunks: And from him, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who doubts in the Fajr prayer. He said: “He repeats it.” I said: “And the Maghrib?” He said: “Yes, and the Witr and the Jumuʿah, without my having to ask him.”

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn salat
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat
key_terms.يَشُكُّ: has doubt regarding the performance of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on doubting in Fajr, Maghrib, Witr, and Jumuʿah prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt in certain prayers. It states that if doubt occurs in Fajr, Maghrib, Witr, and Jumuʿah prayer, the prayer is to be repeated.
